Tim Hortons Doughnut Menu with Prices & Calories in Canada (2026)

Fresh doughnuts and hot coffee have always been a winning combination in Canada. Whether you’re starting your morning or taking an afternoon break, Tim Hortons remains one of the most popular places to enjoy delicious bakery treats. The Tim Hortons Doughnut Menu features everything from light glazed favourites to rich filled doughnuts and seasonal creations. With plenty of flavours to choose from, it’s easy to find something that matches your taste. Besides doughnuts, many customers also enjoy breakfast sandwiches and hot drinks during the same visit. If you’re planning a complete meal, it’s worth exploring the Tim Hortons Breakfast Menu for more delicious options.

In this guide, you’ll find the latest flavours, estimated prices, calorie information, customer favourites, and helpful ordering tips to make your next visit even better.

What Is on the Tim Hortons Doughnut Menu?

The Tim Hortons Doughnut Menu includes classic doughnuts, premium filled varieties, cake doughnuts, seasonal specials, and the famous Timbits. Popular choices include Boston Cream, Honey Cruller, Honey Dip, Chocolate Dip, Apple Fritter, Canadian Maple, and Double Chocolate.

Most locations also offer sharing boxes, making it easy to pick up fresh bakery treats for family gatherings, office meetings, or weekend celebrations.

Why Canadians Love These Doughnuts

For decades, these bakery favourites have been part of everyday life across Canada. Their fresh taste, affordable prices, and familiar flavours keep customers coming back year after year. Another reason for their popularity is the variety. Whether you prefer light glazed options or rich filled doughnuts, there’s something for every sweet craving. Seasonal bakery items also keep the menu exciting. New flavours appear throughout the year, giving customers another reason to stop by and try something different.

Why They’re So Popular

  • Fresh doughnuts served throughout the day
  • Affordable prices for every budget
  • Wide variety of doughnut flavours
  • Seasonal bakery specials
  • Perfect with hot or cold drinks
  • Great for sharing with friends and family

Classic Doughnuts Everyone Should Try

Classic doughnuts continue to be customer favourites because they’re simple, fresh, and full of flavour. They’re also an excellent choice if you’re visiting Tim Hortons for the first time. These long-time favourites pair well with coffee and are available at most locations throughout the year.

Honey Dip

Honey Dip is one of the simplest yet most loved doughnuts on the menu. Its soft texture and light honey glaze create a balanced sweetness that’s never overwhelming. It’s a great choice if you prefer classic bakery flavours without rich fillings.

Chocolate Dip

Chocolate Dip remains a favourite among customers of all ages. The fluffy dough and smooth chocolate icing create a delicious combination. If you enjoy chocolate but don’t want a filled doughnut, this is an excellent option.

Honey Cruller

Honey Cruller is easy to recognise because of its twisted shape and airy texture. Every bite feels light, making it a popular choice with coffee lovers. Its delicate honey glaze adds just enough sweetness without becoming too rich.

Apple Fritter

Apple Fritter is one of the largest items in the bakery selection. Pieces of apple and hints of cinnamon give it a comforting homemade flavour. Many customers choose it when they want something more filling than a traditional ring doughnut.

Premium Filled Doughnuts Worth Trying

If you enjoy rich and creamy desserts, the premium doughnuts are a great choice. They come with smooth fillings, delicious toppings, and bold flavours that make every bite more satisfying. These bakery favourites are perfect when you’re craving something beyond a classic glazed doughnut.

Boston Cream

Boston Cream is one of the most famous doughnuts at Tim Hortons. It features soft yeast dough filled with smooth vanilla custard. A rich layer of chocolate icing adds the perfect finishing touch. The balance of chocolate and cream makes it a customer favourite. If you’re visiting for the first time, this is one doughnut you shouldn’t miss.

Canadian Maple

Canadian Maple offers a flavour that’s loved across the country. It combines soft dough with creamy maple filling and a sweet maple glaze. The rich maple taste isn’t overly sweet, making it enjoyable with almost any hot drink. Many customers pair it with drinks from the Tim Hortons Coffee Menu for a classic Canadian combination.

Double Chocolate

Double Chocolate is made for serious chocolate lovers. The cake-style dough is rich, moist, and full of chocolate flavour. Its chocolate coating makes every bite even more indulgent. It’s a great choice when you want a dessert-style bakery treat.

Dream Doughnuts

Dream Doughnuts are premium bakery creations released for a limited time. They often feature colourful toppings, cookie pieces, and flavoured cream fillings. The available flavours change throughout the year, so every visit can bring something new.

Which Doughnut Should You Choose?

Choosing the right doughnut depends on your personal taste. Some customers enjoy light glazed options, while others prefer rich filled treats. Honey Dip and Honey Cruller are ideal if you like simple flavours. Boston Cream and Canadian Maple are better if you enjoy creamy fillings. If chocolate is your favourite, Double Chocolate is an excellent choice. Apple Fritter is perfect when you want something larger and more filling.

Best Doughnuts for Every Taste

Doughnut Boxes for Sharing

Planning a family gathering or office meeting? Buying a doughnut box is often the most convenient option. Most restaurants offer mixed boxes, allowing everyone to enjoy different flavours in one order. Before placing a large order, it’s worth checking the Tim Hortons Doughnuts Box Prices for the latest options.

A Perfect Match with Coffee

Fresh doughnuts taste even better with a hot drink. Many customers enjoy pairing Boston Cream with Original Blend coffee, while Honey Cruller goes perfectly with Dark Roast. If you prefer iced beverages, a refreshing drink from the Tim Hortons Iced Capp Menu is another popular choice during warmer months.

More Than Just Doughnuts

While doughnuts are one of the biggest attractions, the bakery offers much more. You’ll also find cookies, croissants, bagels, pastries, and other baked treats throughout the day. If you’re looking for even more baked options, the Tim Hortons Bakery Menu includes a variety of fresh items to enjoy with your favourite drink.

Tim Hortons Timbits Menu

Timbits are one of the most loved bakery items at Tim Hortons. These bite-sized treats are perfect for sharing and let you enjoy different flavours in one order. They’re a popular choice for birthdays, office meetings, family gatherings, and road trips. If you’re planning to buy a box, explore the Tim Hortons Timbits Menu to see the latest flavours and pack sizes.

Timbits Box Sizes

Tim Hortons offers different box sizes to suit every occasion. Whether you’re buying a quick snack or catering an event, there’s a sharing option available.

Mixed boxes are usually the most popular because everyone can enjoy their favourite flavours.

Seasonal & Limited-Time Doughnuts

Alongside its everyday favourites, Tim Hortons also introduces limited-time doughnuts during special occasions. These seasonal treats often feature colourful toppings, festive decorations, or unique fillings inspired by holidays and Canadian celebrations. Common seasonal releases include:

  • Valentine’s Day
  • Easter
  • Canada Day
  • Halloween
  • Christmas

Since these items are available for a short time, they often sell out quickly.

Top Doughnuts Worth Ordering First

If you’re unsure what to order, these customer favourites are a great place to start.

Boston Cream

Soft dough, creamy vanilla custard, and chocolate icing make Boston Cream one of the most popular choices on the menu.

Honey Cruller

Its light texture and delicate honey glaze make Honey Cruller a favourite for customers who prefer less sweetness.

Apple Fritter

Apple Fritter combines apple pieces with cinnamon flavour to create a larger, more filling bakery treat.

Chocolate Dip

Chocolate Dip keeps things simple with fluffy dough and smooth chocolate icing. It’s one of the safest choices for chocolate lovers.

Honey Dip

Honey Dip remains a timeless favourite thanks to its soft texture and light honey glaze.

Perfect Coffee Pairings for Every Doughnut

The right drink can make your favourite doughnut even more enjoyable.

You can discover even more hot and cold beverages on the Tim Hortons Coffee Menu. If you prefer something refreshing, the Tim Hortons Drinks Menu also includes lemonades, Refreshers, and other cold beverages.

How Tim Hortons Keeps Its Doughnuts Fresh

Freshness is one of the biggest reasons customers keep returning to Tim Hortons. Most bakery items are prepared using standardised recipes to deliver the same great taste across Canada. Popular doughnuts such as Boston Cream, Honey Cruller, and Chocolate Dip are usually restocked throughout the day. This helps customers enjoy fresher bakery items during busy hours.

If you want the best selection, visit in the morning or before lunchtime. Seasonal favourites and premium doughnuts often sell out first.

Smart Tips Before You Order

A few simple tips can help you get better value and enjoy a wider selection.

  • Visit early for the freshest doughnuts.
  • Ask about seasonal or limited-time flavours.
  • Mix classic and filled doughnuts for more variety.
  • Order a 6-pack or 12-pack if you’re buying for a group.
  • Check the Tim Hortons Nutrition Menu if you’re comparing calories.
  • Pair your doughnut with a drink from the Tim Hortons Coffee Menu.

If you’re ordering breakfast, explore the Tim Hortons Breakfast Menu to complete your meal.

Final Words

The Tim Hortons Doughnut Menu offers a delicious mix of classic favourites, premium filled options, and seasonal bakery treats. Whether you enjoy a simple Honey Dip or a rich Boston Cream, there’s a flavour for every craving. With reasonable prices, fresh bakery items, and plenty of variety, it’s easy to see why these doughnuts remain a favourite across Canada. Check your local restaurant for the latest flavours and enjoy your next sweet treat with confidence.
